business_problem: Swissbit needed to replace siloed quoting, order tracking, reseller communications, and service workflows with a single operational system that could support long, bespoke manufacturing deals and improve forecasting accuracy.
solution_summary: Swissbit built its digitized customer operations on the Salesforce Platform to connect quoting, reseller sales, ERP transactions, service cases, and forecasting on one manufacturing-friendly CRM foundation. Agentforce Manufacturing supports quoting and complex customer agreements so teams can see each order at a glance instead of maintaining spreadsheets and emails across long-running projects. Experience Cloud gives resellers a portal to register products and convert opportunities, while ERP integrations bring transactional and shipping data back into Salesforce so sales teams can trace a project from quote to delivery. On the service side, Agentforce Service and web-to-case route support tickets to the right technician with shared visibility across the company, letting Swissbit forecast capacity earlier, respond faster, and use a single source of truth for both growth planning and customer service.
data_flow: Reseller registrations, quotes, and service requests enter Salesforce, ERP transactions and shipping data are synchronized into the platform, and the combined operational record is used by sales, service, and supply-chain teams to forecast demand and respond to customers from one place.
business_outcome: Swissbit gained end-to-end order visibility, better reseller collaboration, more accurate supply-chain forecasting, and service teams that can respond quickly without handoffs across disconnected systems.
